_comment: Master list of every tuned fused_moe config produced on this hardware.
The filename vLLM opens encodes only (E, N, device_name, dtype). It does
NOT encode K (hidden size), so 'shape_key' alone does not identify a
config -- 'k' is recorded separately and is why by-deployment/ exists.
safe_to_deploy is 0. That is the finding. See ../tuning/README.md.

summary.note: Two sweeps completed. The int8 config measured 0.786x prefill / 0.925x decode; the int4 config was flat at the tuned size and 0.678x prefill. Neither is a tuning failure so much as an M-coverage failure: nearest-M matching has no fallback, so decode-only configs are applied to prefill. Recorded so the sweep is not repeated.
